关于青山的故事(A Story about the green hill): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:杰克与大卫的经历和小计划。
It takes twenty minutes to get to the green hill by bike. David's birthday is in August. David is interested in swimming. In fact, the house sits on top of a hill.
Jack thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Jack spent the weekend at the gym. Jack and David had great fun there. For example, rabbits have long ears.
They took many photos at the forest path. Jack hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Jack borrowed a book about math from the gym. The roads are icy after the storm.
Life is full of small surprises. The green hill is one of the best places in the city. Jack learned a lot about math.
